references.phrase: subset tau of the power set of X
generated sigma-algebra from open family tau
references.context: Smallest sigma-algebra on X that contains all sets open in topology tau.

references.phrase: intersection of all containing sigma algebras
references.context: Intersection of the family of sigma algebras on X with tau included; this satisfies the same sigma-algebra axioms.

references.disposition: The topology tau is essential input; Borel sigma-algebra is not generally the full power set.

review_rationale: Read Borel sigma-algebra generated by every open subset of a topological space as the least sigma-algebra, including equivalent intersection over all containing sigma-algebras.
